name: Nha Trang Beach
kicker: The city sand along Trần Phú
summary: City sand on Trần Phú: swim and walk the seven-kilometre shore for a beach day on the bay. Hotels face that sand. January to August are the dry months, with rain from September to December. After dark the same shore is the walk, and the night market is the 137 m street behind 46 Trần Phú.
getThere: You are on Trần Phú. Cam Ranh is about 27 to 30 km south.
heroCaption: The city sand, the wash, and the towers along Trần Phú
body: This is the beach the city is for. Trần Phú is a seven-kilometre beach, and the day is on that sand. Hotels face the shore. Swim by day and walk the same sand after dark.
January to August are the dry months, and September to December are the rainy months. The average temperature is 26°C.
The night market is the 137 m walking street behind the cultural centre at 46 Trần Phú, in Lộc Thọ. Entry is free.

figures.caption: Swimmers in the wash, from the same photograph as the long shore
figures.alt: People standing in the shallow water on Nha Trang’s city beach

gettingThere: The sand is Trần Phú. From a hotel on that road you walk out. Cam Ranh is about 27 to 30 km south of the centre, and the city lies to the north of the airport. Shuttles, taxis, and ride-hailing cover that ride.

legs.heading: From Trần Phú
legs.body: You are already on the beach road. The night market is behind 46 Trần Phú.

legs.heading: From the airport
legs.body: About 27 to 30 km south of the centre.

legs.heading: From the station
legs.body: The station is in the centre. Walk or ride out to Trần Phú from there.

admissionNote: Island boats and the cable are separate.
